name: ratedwithai
description: Check a live public website for WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA accessibility issues with axe-core, and get plain-English fix steps for each failing rule.

interface.longDescription:
RatedWithAI checks a live public website for accessibility problems. Give it an address and it loads the page in a real browser, runs the axe-core WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA rules on it and on up to two more pages from the same site, and returns a 0-100 score, a letter grade and the failing rules, ordered by severity, with how many elements each affects and example markup. Ask about any rule it reports (for example color-contrast or image-alt) and it explains what the rule means and how to fix it, with a code example.

Useful for site owners, developers, designers and agencies checking a site against WCAG, the ADA, Section 508 or the European Accessibility Act before launch, after a redesign, or after receiving a complaint.

Limitations: it only loads public http(s) pages, not pages behind a login, local or private-network addresses, or pasted HTML. A scan takes 15-40 seconds. Automated testing finds roughly a third to a half of WCAG issues; results are not legal advice or a compliance certification.
capabilities: Scan a website for accessibility issues
Explain how to fix an accessibility rule
defaultPrompt: Check my website example.com for accessibility issues.
Is my site ADA and WCAG compliant? It's at example.com
How do I fix the color-contrast accessibility error?

positive.description: Scan a public site by bare domain
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a 0-100 score and letter grade for https://apistatuscheck.com/ across up to 3 pages, lists failing axe rules ordered critical to minor with element counts and WCAG criteria, and states that automated testing is not a legal compliance certification.

positive.description: Compliance-phrased request maps to a scan
positive.prompt: Is https://www.gov.uk ADA and WCAG compliant?
positive.expected_behavior: Runs a scan and reports the score, grade and any failing rules, and says that an automated scan cannot certify ADA compliance.

positive.description: Explain a rule returned by a scan
positive.prompt: How do I fix the color-contrast accessibility error?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the color-contrast rule in plain English with numbered fix steps, an HTML/CSS code example and a reference link to the axe rule page.

positive.description: Scan, then explain the top issue
positive.prompt: Scan example.com for accessibility issues and tell me how to fix the most serious one.
positive.expected_behavior: Scans the site, identifies the highest-impact failing rule, then calls explain_accessibility_issue with that rule id and returns its fix steps.

positive.description: Unknown rule id is handled honestly
positive.prompt: What does the accessibility rule 'made-up-rule' mean and how do I fix it?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that there is no written guide for that rule id, gives the axe-core reference link, and lists the rule ids that do have guides.

negative.description: General accessibility-law question should not trigger a scan
negative.prompt: What is the difference between the ADA and Section 508?

negative.description: Private or local address must be refused
Pasted HTML is not a website the scanner can load

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything or process payments. Scans and fix explanations are free inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: scan_accessibility (axe-core WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA scan of up to 3 public pages, score, grade and failing rules) and explain_accessibility_issue (fix steps and a code example for an axe rule).
